verses.text: Ha t'a skal heb' kreyente t'a chonhab' Antioquía chi', ay juntzanh heb' winh syak' Dios yalanel slolonel. Ay pax ek' juntzanh heb' winh sk'ayb'umal heb' kreyente. Ayek' winhaj Bernabé, winhaj Simón skuchanpax Niger, winhaj Lucio aj chonhab' Cirene yet' winhaj Saulo. Ayek' pax winhaj Manaén, haton winh junnhej q'uib'nak yet' winhaj Herodes, winh ak'jinak yajalil t'a Galilea.

Ha junel wan yalan sb'a heb' t'a Dios Kajal. Ay pax och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Haxo Yespíritu Dios ix halan t'a heb': --Tze sik'elta winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo, yik ol munlaj heb' winh b'aj ol wak'och yopisio, xchi.
Yuj chi' ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix lesalwi heb'. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo chi', ix schekanb'at heb' winh heb'.

Ix chekjib'at winhaj Bernabé yet' winhaj Saulo yuj Yespíritu Dios. Ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Seleucia. Haxo ta' ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barko, ix b'at heb' winh t'a jun lugar skuch Chipre ay t'a snanhal ha' mar.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Salamina, ix ek' yalankanel slolonel Dios heb' winh t'a yoltak spatil kulto. Haxo winhaj Juan Marcos, ajun pax winh yet' heb' winh, yik skolwaj winh yet' heb' winh.

Ix b'atxi heb' winh. Ix k'axpajek' heb' winh t'a Chipre chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Pafos. Hata' ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh yet' jun winh israel skuch Barjesús. Ha jun winh chi', syaloch sb'a winh ajb'aalil. Syal pax winh to ha Dios tz'ak'an yalel slolonel.

Ha jun winh chi', junnhej tzek' winh yet' winhaj Sergio Paulo, winh yajal t'a Chipre chi'. Te jelan spensar winhaj Sergio chi'. Ix yawtejkot winhaj Bernabé winh yet' winhaj Saulo, yujto snib'ej winh syab' slolonel Dios t'a heb' winh.
Palta haxo winh syaloch sb'a ajb'aalil chi', haton winh skuchan pax Elimas, ix yak'elta yowal winh t'a heb' winh, yujto snib'ej winh max yak'och slolonel Dios winhaj Sergio chi' t'a sk'ool.
Haxo winhaj Saulo chi', haton winh skuchpax Pablo, te ayoch Espíritu Santo t'a winh. Ix och k'elan winh t'a winh syaloch sb'a ajb'aalil chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, tzak' musansatil heb' anima. Te chuk a pensar. Yuninal ach winh diablo. Ajk'ol ach t'a masanil tas wach'. Ha slolonel Kajal Jesús te yel. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj max aktejkan ixtani?

Ha tiknaik, ol yak'kot yaelal Kajal Jesús t'a ib'anh. Ol yak' ixtax yol a sat, yuj chi' manhxo ol yal-laj ilan yok k'u junok tiempoal, xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a winh. T'a jun rato chi', ix ixtax yol sat winh. Majxo yal yilan jab'ok winh. Yuj chi', ix machmonek' winh, ix snib'ej winh to ay junok mach sketzan b'eyek'ok.
Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winh yajal t'a Chipre chi', ix yak'och Dios winh t'a sk'ool. Ix te sat pax sk'ool winh yab'an juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Kajal Jesús.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix och heb' winh t'a yol jun barko. Ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a chonhab' Pafos, ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Perge t'a yol yik Panfilia. Palta haxo winhaj Juan Marcos, ix aktajkan heb' winh yuj winh, ix meltzajkan winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén.
Ix b'atxi heb' winh t'a Perge chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a chonhab' Antioquía t'a yol yik Pisidia. Haxo t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix och heb' winh t'a yol spatil kulto, ix em k'ojjab' heb' winh ta'.

Hata' ix awtaj ch'anh ley Moisés yet' juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Ixlajwi chi', a heb' skuchb'an heb' t'a kulto ix halan t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi': --Ex ketanimail, tato ay junok tas he gana tzeyak' sk'ayb'ej heb' anima, syal eyalan tiknaik, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix k'e waan winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix yik'an chaanh sk'ab' winh yik numan tz'aj heb'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetisraelal yet' ex manh ex israelok ay he xiwk'olal t'a Dios, ab'ek:

Ha ko Diosal a onh aj Israel onh tik, a sik'jinakkanel heb' ko mam kicham. Ayik yek'nak heb' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto, A' ak'jinakkan och heb' niwak chonhab'il. Slajwi chi', yik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto chi' yet' sniwan poder.
Yak'nak techaj Dios chi' sb'eyb'al heb' 40 ab'il t'a tzinan lu'um chi'.
Hanhejtona', A' ak'jinak satel uke' nakión ay t'a yol yik Canaán. Haxo sluum heb' b'aj satnakel chi', ak'jinakkan yikok heb' ko mam kicham.
450 ab'il yak'nak heb' icha chi'. Slajwinak chi', haxo Dios ak'annak yopisio juntzanh heb' juez yak'an mandar heb', masanto yochnak winhaj Samuel schekab'ok Dios.

Haxo t'a jun pekti' chi', sk'annak junok sreyal heb' t'a Dios, yik a skuchb'an heb', haxo winhaj Saúl ak'jioch sreyalok heb' yuj Dios. Ha winhaj Saúl chi', a winhaj Cis ay yuninal winh, winh yinhtilal Benjamín. 40 ab'il ochnak winh sreyalok heb'.

Haxo Dios ik'jinakel winh t'a yopisio chi'. Haxo winhaj David yak'xikanoch sk'exulok winh. Yalannak Dios icha tik yuj winh: Ina yajek' winhaj David winh yuninal winhaj Isaí, haton jun winh tik tzin tzalaj yet'ok. Ha winh ol b'oan masanil tas in gana, xchi.
Haxo Jesús, a winhaj David chi' ay yinhtilalkani. Ha Dios ak'jinakkan yopisio yoch ko Kolumalok a onh israel onh tik, icha ix aj yak'ankan sti'.
Ayik manto yamchajoch smunlajel chi', a winhaj Juan ix alanel t'a heb' ketisraelal to yowalil sna sb'a heb', syak'an ak'jok bautizar sb'a heb'.

Haxo yik wanxo slajwi yopisio winhaj Juan chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha he naani to he Kolumal in, palta maay. Ay jun tzak'an sja wuuj, a jun chi' te niwan yelk'ochi. Hanhejtona' in, manh in mojok wak'an serwil, wach'chom tonhej tzin tijel xanhab', xchi winh.
Ex wetanimail, ex yinhtilal Abraham wet'ok yet' ex ay he xiwk'olal t'a Dios, a jun ab'ix yik kolnab'il tik, heyik wet'ok.

Palta a heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' yajal, max nachajel-laj yuj heb' tato a Jesús chi' Yuninal Dios, wach'chom t'a junjun k'ual ik'oj ip, ix yab'an heb' yawtaj tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios, palta maj nachajel-laj yuj heb'. Yuj chi', ayik ix yak'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh Jesús chi', ix yak'elk'och juntzanh tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi' heb'.
Malaj jab'ok smul ix ilchaj yuj heb', manh smojok smilancham heb'. Palta xit' sk'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh t'a winhaj Pilato, haton winh yajal.

Ix laj yak'elk'och heb' t'ay icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Slolonel Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ay heb' ochnak tzak'an yet' Jesús ix ik'anemta sniwanil t'a spenek te' kulus. Ix b'at smukanoch heb' t'a yol jun k'een k'een.
Haxo Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak.

Ixlajwi chi', tzijtumto k'ual ix ek' yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Haton heb' kot yet' t'a Galilea sk'och heb' t'a Jerusalén yet'ok ayik manto chami. Ha heb' chi', wan yalanel yab'ixal heb' t'a skal heb' anima tiknaik.
Ichonh pax ta' a onh tik wan kalan pax el jun wach' ab'ix tik t'ayex, to ha Dios yak'nakkan sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Haxo t'ayonh ix yak'elk'och sti' chi'. Ayik ix pitzwixi Jesús, ix elk'och jun yalnakkan chi'. Icha yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a Salmo 2, b'aj syal icha tik: Ha t'a jun k'u tik, ix wak' cheklajok to Wuninal ach, xchikan Dios t'a Slolonel chi'.

Yalnakkan Dios to ol yik'k'e waan Jesús t'a skal heb' chamnak, yik malaj b'ak'uinh ol k'a sniwanil. Yalnakpaxkan icha tik t'a Slolonel Dios chi': Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'ayex, icha ix wutej wak'ankan in ti' t'a winhaj David, xchi.
Yuj chi', ayokto yalannakkan yab'ixal Cristo winhaj David chi' t'a junxo Salmo b'aj syal icha tik: Mamin, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in ton tik sik'b'il in el uuj, xchi.
Ha winhaj David chi' ak'jinak serwil heb' anima t'a jun pekti' chi', icha snib'ej Dios. Slajwi chi' scham winh, smukchajnak winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham. Haxo sniwanil winh chi' k'anakb'ati.
Palta haxo jun ix yak' pitzwokxi Dios t'a skal heb' chamnak, maj k'alaj sniwanil.
Yuj chi' in gana tzeyojtakejeli to anhej Jesús syal yak'an lajwok ko mul. Yuj chi' wan kalan jun ab'ix tik t'ayex.
Ha ley Moisés max yal-laj yak'an lajwok ko mul. Palta a mach tz'ak'anoch Jesucristo t'a sk'ool, slajwikan smul smasanil yuj.
Yuj chi' naek wal he b'a. Tato maay, a tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj heb' schekab' Dios ol jawok t'a eyib'anh, yujto yalnakkan heb' icha tik:

Ex b'uchumtak, ileknab'i. Satokab' he k'ool heyilani, haxo he satel chi'. Yujto a in Dios in ol in b'o junok tas t'a he tiempoal tik, wach'chom ay mach ol halan t'ayex, palta manh ol he cha eyab'i, xchi Dios chi', xchi winhaj Pablo chi' t'a heb'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo chi' yet' winhaj Bernabé, ayik wan yelta heb' winh t'a yol spatil kulto chi', ay heb' manh israelok ix k'anan t'a heb' winh, yik sk'och heb' winh sk'ayb'ej heb' t'a juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al chi' t'a junxo sk'ual ik'oj ip.

Haxo yik ix lajwi jun kulto chi', a heb' israel, ix b'at heb' yet' winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi'. Ay pax heb' ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel chi' ix b'at pax yet' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi' t'a heb' to tek'an syutej sb'a heb' yak'anoch t'a sk'ool to xajan heb' yuj Dios.
Haxo t'a junxo sk'ual ik'oj ip, kenxonhej maj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima smasanil t'a jun chonhab' chi' smaklej yab' slolonel Dios.
Palta haxo ix yilan heb' israel to tzijtum anima ix smol sb'a, ix chichonoch sk'ool heb' t'a winhaj Pablo chi'. Ix laj yalan heb' to es juntzanh syal winh chi'. Tonhej ix b'uchwaj heb' t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix stek'b'ej sb'a winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi'. Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ex ketisraelal, yowalil a t'ayex sko b'ab'laj alejel slolonel Dios. Palta ina malaj he gana tzeyak'och t'a he k'ool. Tekan a he naani to manh he mojok he chaan he k 'inal t'a junelnhej. Yuj chi' a tiknaik, ha t'a heb' manh israelok ol onh b'at kaleli.

Yujto icha tik yalnakkan Kajal Jesús t'ayonh: Ix wak' opisio a ch'oxan in sakil k'inal t'a heb' manh israelok, yik wach' ay heb' ol kolchajel t'a junjun lugar masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo heb' manh israelok ix te tzalaj sk'ool heb' yab'an juntzanh chi'. Ix och ijan heb' yalani to te wach' slolonel Kajal Jesús. Haxo heb' sik'b'ilxoel yuj Dios yik scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'ool.
Icha chi' ix aj spukaxb'at slolonel Kajal Jesús chi' t'a jun lugar chi' smasanil.

Palta haxo heb' israel ix ak'an sk'ool heb' yajal t'a jun chonhab' chi'. Ay pax juntzanh heb' ix ix ochnak t'a sk'ayb'ub'al heb' israel chi', chekel yaj heb' ix t'a sat heb' anima, ix ak'jipax sk'ool heb' ix. Ix och ijan heb' yak'an chukal t'a winhaj Pablo yet' t'a winhaj Bernabé chi'. Ix pechjiel heb' winh t'a jun lugar chi' yuj heb'.

Haxo winhaj Pablo yet' winhaj Bernabé chi', ix stzikkanel spokokal yok heb' winh, yik sch'oxanel heb' winh to manhxa yalan yik heb' winh t'a heb' anima chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a chonhab' Iconio.
Haxo heb' kreyente aj Antioquía chi', ix te tzalaj heb'. Te ay wal och Espíritu Santo t'a heb'.
